consent.heading: DPDP Consent Notice
consent.prototypeNote: This notice demonstrates the UI shape a consent flow would have.
consent.noticeIntro: By accepting, you acknowledge that SAATHI may process the information you provide (name, email, and the details you enter into forms like the registration wizard) for the following purposes:

noticeItems.purpose: Purpose: to provide account, dashboard, and application-tracking features.
noticeItems.dataUsed: Data used: the name/email you sign in with, plus any details you type into SAATHI's forms.
noticeItems.retention: Retention: stored only in this browser (localStorage) — nothing is sent to or kept on a real server.
noticeItems.rights: Your rights: you can request or delete your data at any time by clearing your browser's storage.

consent.signInToRecord: Sign in to record your acceptance of this notice.
consent.acceptButton: I have read and accept this notice
